sections.heading: Getting started
paragraphs: A friend visited Khaled at home for the first time. They walked through the rooms and talked about everyday objects and habits. Khaled said, “Welcome to my home.” His friend replied, “Please come inside.” Khaled said, “You can leave your shoes here.” His friend replied, “The living room is on the left.” Khaled said, “The kitchen is next to it.” His friend replied, “Would you like some water?” Khaled said, “Make yourself comfortable.” His friend replied, “This chair is very comfortable.” Khaled said, “The window lets in a lot of light.” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: A useful exchange
paragraphs: As they continued, they learned to explain what they needed. Khaled said, “I usually read in this corner.” His friend replied, “The bedroom is upstairs.” Khaled said, “The bathroom is down the hall.” His friend replied, “Please close the door gently.” Khaled said, “Can you turn on the light?” His friend replied, “The air conditioner is running.” Khaled said, “It feels cool in here.” His friend replied, “I need to clean the table.” Khaled said, “The dishes are in the sink.” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: Making it clearer
paragraphs: They listened, asked questions, and tried the next useful expressions. Khaled said, “I will wash them after lunch.” His friend replied, “Where did I leave my keys?” Khaled said, “They are beside the television.” His friend replied, “I cannot find the remote control.” Khaled said, “Look under the sofa.” His friend replied, “The laundry is ready.” Khaled said, “I need to fold these clothes.” His friend replied, “Could you open the curtains?” Khaled said, “There is a small balcony outside.” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: Ending well
paragraphs: Before leaving, they finished the conversation warmly. Khaled said, “I like keeping things organized.” His friend replied, “We have a guest room as well.” Khaled said, “Let me show you around.” His friend replied, “The house is quiet at night.” Khaled said, “Please feel at home.” His friend replied, “Thank you for visiting us.” Khaled said, “You are welcome any time.” They felt more confident after practising together.
